title: Emil Siriwardane is an associate professor of business administration in the Finance Unit.
bio: Overview In his research, Professor Siriwardane seeks to develop a quantitative understanding of how the financial sector affects asset prices and macroeconomic stability, particularly relevant in the wake of the financial crisis of the last decade.

Siriwardane Finnegan Family Associate Professor of Business Administration Finnegan Family Associate Professor of Business Administration Emil Siriwardane is an associate professor of business administration in the Finance Unit. Professor Siriwardane’s research studies the ways in which financial intermediaries influence capital markets, how perceptions of risk impact business cycles, and more recently, how public pensions make investment decisions. Professor Siriwardane earned his PhD in finance from the Stern School of Business at New York University and a BSE in operations research and financial engineer
